target: home margin of victory (points), full game including overtime

outputs.expected_margin: sum of weight x feature, plus home_field when the site is not neutral
outputs.p_home: P(home wins) from the fitted margin distribution (key numbers), a tie counted as half
outputs.expected_total: total_a + total_b x expected drives x expected points per drive (both offenses)

features.name: pass
features.description: Expected net pass EPA per game: home minus away (offense vs opposing defense) EPA per dropback times league dropbacks per team-game
features.available: filtered state after every completed game before the prediction (point in time)

features.name: rush
features.description: Expected net rush EPA per game, built the same way from rushing plays
features.available: filtered state after every completed game before the prediction (point in time)

features.name: succ
features.description: Expected success-rate difference (home offense vs away defense minus the reverse)
features.available: filtered state after every completed game before the prediction (point in time)

features.name: ppd
features.description: Expected net points from drives: points-per-drive difference times league drives per team-game
features.available: filtered state after every completed game before the prediction (point in time)

features.name: st
features.description: Expected net special-teams EPA per game
features.available: filtered state after every completed game before the prediction (point in time)

features.name: qb
features.description: Expected starting quarterback's rating relative to the team's baseline quarterback, net of the opponent's

features.name: avail_ol
